propDocs.NavigationMenu.orientation: Controls top-level layout, keyboard directions and the default panel side.
propDocs.NavigationMenu.openOnHover: Resting on a trigger opens its panel; presses always work.
propDocs.NavigationMenu.closeOnSelect: Closes after an ordinary link selection.
propDocs.NavigationMenuContent.keepMounted: Keeps closed panel content in the document, hidden.
propDocs.NavigationMenuContent.hiddenUntilFound: Allows browser find to open matching closed panels; implies keepMounted.
propDocs.NavigationMenuViewport.side: Preferred side; omit to follow the menu orientation.
propDocs.NavigationMenuViewport.align: Start, center or end alignment with the open trigger.
propDocs.NavigationMenuLink.current: Marks the current page and positions the indicator there while closed.
